---
title: Instructions for Replacing `bit`
---

The `bit` library has been **deprecated** and is no longer maintained.

It has been replaced by a new C++ library [`gf2`][gf2_docs] with many additional features and improvements. <br>
That library is available at this [repository][gf2_repo] and has its own comprehensive [documentation site][gf2_docs].

There is also a companion `gf2` Rust _crate_ with similar functionality available on [crates.io][gf2_crate]. <br>
The source code for the crate is available at [this repository][gf2_rs_repo], and its documentation is at [docs.rs][gf2_rs_docs].
